name: Home
description: Home Assistant at a glance: lights, doors and windows, camera alerts, weather and today's calendar

settings.name: token
settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.help: Home Assistant -> your profile -> Security -> Long-lived access tokens

settings.name: location
settings.label: Weather location
settings.help: A place (Warszawa) or coordinates (52.23, 21.01). Empty: the home zone from Home Assistant.

settings.name: lights
settings.label: Lights to watch
settings.help: Entity ids, * allowed, comma separated (light.*, switch.lamp_*). Empty: every light.

settings.name: contacts
settings.label: Doors and windows to watch
settings.help: Entity ids, * allowed. Empty: every door, window, garage door and opening sensor.

settings.name: alerts
settings.label: Alert sensors
settings.help: Entity ids that raise an alert when on or fired, e.g. binary_sensor.*_person, event.doorbell. Empty: no alerts.

settings.name: alert_minutes
settings.label: Keep an alert for (minutes)
settings.help: How long an alert stays after the sensor goes quiet.

settings.name: weather_alerts
settings.label: Weather warning sensors
settings.help: Optional Home Assistant entities with official warnings (e.g. binary_sensor.meteoalarm). Forecast-based warnings are always on.

settings.name: calendars
settings.label: Calendars
settings.help: Calendar entity ids from Home Assistant, * allowed. Empty: every calendar.
